 Regular or Temporary: 
Regular 
 Language Fluency:  English (Required)
 
 Work Shift: 
1st shift (United States of America) 
 
 Please review the following job description: 
 
An Informatica Developer is responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining ETL (Extract, Transform, Load) processes using Informatica tools. The role involves working closely with data functional teams to ensure efficient data integration, transformation, and delivery. Strong Unix/Linux scripting skills are required to support automation, scheduling, and batch processing activities. 
 
 ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES 
Following is a summary of the essential functions for this job. Other duties may be performed, both major and minor, which are not mentioned below. Specific activities may change from time to time.
 Key Responsibilities 
 Design, develop, and implement ETL workflows using Informatica PowerCenter 
 Create and maintain mappings, workflows, sessions, and transformations 
 Develop data integration solutions to extract, transform, and load data from multiple sources 
 Perform data analysis, validation, and troubleshooting of ETL processes 
 Optimize ETL performance and implement tuning strategies 
 Develop and maintain Unix shell scripts for job automation, scheduling, and monitoring 
 Work with SQL queries, stored procedures, and database objects for data processing 
 Support production deployments, issue resolution, and maintenance activities 
 Collaborate with business analysts and stakeholders to understand requirements 
 Ensure data quality, integrity, and compliance with standards 
 Participate in SDLC phases : requirements, design, development, testing, and deployment 
 Required Technical Skills 
 Informatica PowerCenter / Informatica Cloud (IICS) 
 Strong knowledge of ETL development and data warehousing concepts 
 Proficiency in SQL (Oracle, SQL Server, DB2, etc.) 
 Hands-on experience with Unix/Linux and Shell scripting 
 Experience in data modeling and database design 
 Knowledge of workflow scheduling tools (e.g., Control-M, Autosys) 
 Understanding of performance tuning and optimization techniques 
 Experience working with multiple data sources (XML, flat files, RDBMS) 
 Preferred/Additional Skills 
 Familiarity with Agile methodologies 
 Experience with version control and release management 
 Soft Skills 
 Strong analytical and problem-solving skills 
 Good communication and collaboration abilities 
 Attention to detail and accuracy 
 Ability to work independently and within teams 
 
 General Description of Available Benefits for Eligible Employees of Truist Financial Corporation: All regular teammates (not temporary or contingent workers) working 20 hours or more per week are eligible for benefits, though eligibility for specific benefits may be determined by the division of Truist offering the position. Truist offers medical, dental, vision, life insurance, disability, accidental death and dismemberment, tax-preferred savings accounts, and a 401k plan to teammates. Teammates also receive no less than 10 days of vacation (prorated based on date of hire and by full-time or part-time status) during their first year of employment, along with 10 sick days (also prorated), and paid holidays. For more details on Truist’s generous benefit plans, please visit our Benefits site . Depending on the position and division, this job may also be eligible for Truist’s defined benefit pension plan, restricted stock units, and/or a deferred compensation plan. As you advance through the hiring process, you will also learn more about the specific benefits available for any non-temporary position for which you apply, based on full-time or part-time status, position, and division of work.
